property: After an admissible interrupted manifest append, recovery must open the last durable coherent version and retain every acknowledged Sync write; complete malformed records must not be silently accepted as a legal tail.
method: Independent acknowledged map compared after actual Open/recovery. Require successful recovery for legal incomplete envelope states; malformed complete-record control requires detected corruption, not silent success. Preserve uncertainty for writes without observed successful Sync result.
witness_requirements: Version-edit record/block boundaries, WAL/SST/manifest identities and fences, flush/compaction/publication dependencies, legal crash image, recovery parser verdict and acknowledged/recovered values.
